question: Can the unchanged approved B01 job pass the frozen F0.5 workflow after the bounded media-type and observed-render-call harness correction?

recoveryContract.interruptionPoint: After source/profile validation and READY_FOR_RENDER marker, before the RENDER_CALL_BEGIN marker and bpy.ops.render.render.

negativeControls.rendererInterruption: Supervisor sends SIGTERM only after READY_FOR_RENDER and verifies zero observed render calls and no final EXR or success receipt.
negativeControls.tamperedReceipt: An in-memory copy of the preview receipt is modified without a valid self hash; recovery rejects it before a product start.
negativeControls.insufficientDisk: Actual free space is evaluated against an 80 GiB projected write plus the 100 GiB reserve; rejection occurs before a product start.

acceptance: One approved job produces the frozen EEVEE preview and Cycles multilayer EXR with zero mouse interactions.
Independent product audit decodes preview and EXR pixels, verifies required pass semantics, finite values, nonempty signal and frozen identities.
Process exit, wall/user/system time, peak RSS, disk, artifact bytes, SHA-256 and expected/observed render calls are cross-bound in self-hashed receipts.
The final-stage interruption has zero observed render calls and recovery reruns only final after verifying immutable preview and interruption receipts.
Insufficient disk and tampered receipt controls each reject before launching a native product process.
Source .blend bytes and official Blender configuration remain unchanged.
stopRules: If any preregistered source, product, OCIO, manifest, tool or job identity differs, record BLOCKED and launch no product process.
If any positive admission observes less than 160 GiB free, another Blender process, an existing target output or a projected reserve breach, record BLOCKED.
If preview, interruption, recovery final or independent audit violates a frozen gate after formal start, preserve the root and record FAIL without same-ID repair.
Do not change profiles, pixel thresholds, process budgets or pass requirements after observing formal output.
claimCeiling: A PASS proves one bounded B01 headless preview/final/recovery workflow and its receipts on this product/host. It does not prove animation, GPU rendering, cross-host pixels, cinematic quality, F0.6 merge cost, F0.7 packaging or production readiness.
